description: Java source code for the ExternalAssetOwnersApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing external asset owners, including transfer requests, retrieval of transfer and journal entry data, and search functionality within the Fineract investment module.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing external asset owners and related transfer operations.

methods.name: transferRequestWithLoanId
methods.description: Handles transfer requests for a specific loan ID.

methods.name: transferRequestWithLoanExternalId
methods.description: Handles transfer requests for a loan identified by external ID.

methods.name: transferRequestWithId
methods.description: Handles transfer requests for a specific transfer ID.

methods.name: transferRequestWithExternalId
methods.description: Handles transfer requests for a transfer identified by external ID.

methods.name: getTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transfer data filtered by transferExternalId, loanId, or loanExternalId.

methods.name: getActiveTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves the active transfer data based on transferExternalId, loanId, or loanExternalId.

methods.name: getJournalEntriesOfTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries associated with a specific transfer.

methods.name: getJournalEntriesOfOwner
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries for an owner by external ID.

methods.name: searchInvestorData
methods.description: Searches external asset owner transfer data based on text or date ranges.
